source.goal: Fix file browser rendering so the selected entry remains visible after navigation and terminal resizing whenever there is room for an entry row. At 80x12 with 12 entries and selected_idx=4, item_04.txt is currently invisible because the list assumes at least five rows and wrapped headers consume space. Compute the actual list viewport and ensure long paths/filenames do not make selection disappear. Preserve keyboard selection, file operations, keystore/crypto behavior and unrelated UI.
acceptance: Reproduce and fix the archived 80x12 selected_idx=4 case; add a permanent regression that fails on the old implementation.
Cover navigation down/up, shrinking/resizing, and long or Unicode paths/names. At extremely tiny dimensions render safely; only promise selected text when at least one row fits.
Keep browsing selection and cryptographic/file-operation behavior unchanged; update interface contract and pass the full gate.
